intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Springfield for 2026, and here is what he found: 28 family events, 10 of them free. The magic runs from Light the Park in Bolivar (opening November 22) through December 30, with Free Carriage Rides at Park Central Square (November 27 to December 19), Carson's Aglow (from November 27), Breakfast with Santa in Republic (December 5), Christmas on the Frisco in Willard (December 5) and the Rogersville drive-thru live nativity (December 5 and 6) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Springfield

  • 28 Christmas events for kids in Springfield and nearby towns such as Bolivar, Willard, Republic, Marshfield, Mount Vernon, Rogersville and Lebanon
  • 10 free events, including Free Carriage Rides, A Christmas Stroll in the Park, Light the Park in Bolivar and the Rogersville live nativity
  • Meet Santa: Breakfast with Santa in Republic (December 5, $6), A Christmas Stroll in the Park (December 6), Christmas in the Park in Lebanon (December 4) and Storytime with Santa at the Lebanon library (December 8)
  • Parades and tree lightings: Bolivar Christmas Parade (December 5), Marshfield Christmas Parade (December 5), Christmas on the Frisco Parade in Willard (December 5) and Christmas on the Square in Mount Vernon (December 1)
  • Lights: Light the Park in Bolivar (November 22 to December 30) and Carson's Aglow (from November 27)
  • Trains: none found in the Springfield area beyond what is already listed
  • Season: November 22 to December 30

Planning a bigger day out? Springfield families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Missouri, which covers Branson, Joplin and Silver Dollar City.
